name: California Natural Resources Agency Tribal Nature-Based Solutions Climate Bond Grants
summary: Proposition 4 grants for California tribes and tribally led entities to buy back ancestral land and carry out nature-based projects such as habitat restoration. The 2026 round funds land acquisition; rounds are to recur until funds are used.

amount.note: Minimum for ancestral land return projects; escrow-ready projects have no minimum.

deadline.text: Step 1 Application and Escrow Ready Application due: April 15, 2026

deadline.quote: Step 1 Application and Escrow Ready Application due: April 15, 2026

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include California Native American tribes and tribally led entities located in California.

geography.quote: Projects must be within the State of California and must benefit California Native American Tribes.

access.quote: Applications will be accepted during a defined, annual solicitation period through a 2-Step Application process.

window.quote: Applications will be accepted during a defined, annual solicitation period through a 2-Step Application process.

amount.quote: Ancestral Land Return Projects: Min. award amount is $1,000,000; Max. award amount is total available grant funds. Escrow-Ready Projects: No min. award amount

pool.quote: Approximately $9.2 million is available for tribal multi-benefit nature-based solutions projects

co_finance_required.quote: There is no match funding requirement to participate or be eligible for grant funds.
